premises.text: Irrelevant ads lead to poor user experience and lost revenue for content providers
premises.evidence_span: These ads are not relevant and because of that everybody is losing. The content provider losing money because every click skip this ad.

premises.text: Current advertising targeting relies heavily on user data, which is sold in real-time
premises.evidence_span: all the market leaders like Google, Facebook, they all base targeting on user data and reach. This user data is sold in the online trading desk every millisecond.

premises.text: There is a growing demand for effective online video advertising solutions
premises.evidence_span: the online video advertising is the fastest growing category in the online spending.

premises.text: Relevancy Data's technology enhances ad targeting by analyzing video content
premises.evidence_span: We developed a powerful commercial engine that go beyond face recognition.

premises.text: Using content recognition technology improves ad engagement rates
premises.evidence_span: 42% more people viewed the ads that was based on a recognition technology.

premises.text: The technology can detect multiple elements in videos for better ad targeting
premises.evidence_span: Our engine able to detect today faces, objects, logos, music, gender, age, and even emotion to better target advertising.

premises.text: The company has patented its technology for ad targeting
premises.evidence_span: Because this is so unique, we patented our technology.

premises.text: The company earns revenue from selling data and offering campaign management services
premises.evidence_span: We earn money from selling the data. In additional, we offer a campaign management.

value.text: Advertisers can achieve better targeting and user engagement through advanced content recognition technology
value.evidence_span: imagine how much they're going to spend when you know how each ad to each individual consumer works.

notes: No separate premises for customer count, team experience, or advisory board details as they do not directly impact the theory of value.
